# `billing_run`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

One daily billing run per date (ours, not TMF). Only a billing run writes ABRs and bills; the worker's bookkeeping lives here (trigger, attempt, failure_kind).

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |
| `run_date` | `date` | no |  | The business date the run bills (unique). It sees orders completed before 00:00 of this date (BILLING_TZ); ABRs it writes carry this run date. |
| `status` | `billing_run_status` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | running, completed (every member account ok) or failed (see failure_kind). |
| `started_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the current attempt started (injected clock): the first start, or the last reopen after a failure or takeover of a dead worker's run. |
| `finished_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the run completed or failed; NULL while running. |
| `error` | `text` | yes |  | Why the run failed, for operators. |
| `trigger` | `billing_run_trigger` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | Why the current attempt started: scheduled, catchUp or retry. |
| `attempt` | `integer` | no | `1` | 1 for the first attempt; + 1 on every reopen or takeover. |
| `heartbeat_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Touched after every account; shows a long run is alive. |
| `failure_kind` | `billing_run_failure_kind` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | yes |  | Set exactly when failed: accounts (some account failed or is blocked; later dates go ahead) or run (the run itself failed; no later date is billed until it succeeds). |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `billing_run_attempt_positive` | check | `CHECK ((attempt >= 1))` |
| `billing_run_check` | check | `CHECK ((finished_at >= started_at))` |
| `billing_run_failure_kind_iff_failed` | check | `CHECK (((status = 'failed'::billing_run_status) = (failure_kind IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `billing_run_finished_iff_not_running` | check | `CHECK (((status = 'running'::billing_run_status) = (finished_at IS NULL)))` |
| `billing_run_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
| `billing_run_run_date_key` | unique | `UNIQUE (run_date)` |
